import urllib.request,json,datetime
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/'
out={}
for manifest,field,expected in [('latest.json','revision',9),('native/latest.json','version_code',14)]:
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+manifest,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-store','User-Agent':'OnTrack-Voice-023-Probe'}),timeout=9) as r:
  content=r.read(16000);status=r.status
 envelope=json.loads(content);meta=json.loads(envelope['payload'])
 assert status==200 and int(meta[field])==expected, 'wrong manifest revision'
 asset=('native/' if field=='version_code' else '')+meta['file']
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+asset,method='HEAD'),timeout=9) as r:
  asset_status=r.status;size=int(r.headers.get('Content-Length','0'));ctype=r.headers.get('Content-Type')
 assert asset_status==200 and size==meta['size'], 'public asset size mismatch'
 out[manifest]={'http':status,'asset_status':asset_status,'size':size,'version':expected,'sha256':meta['sha256'],'mime':ctype}
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','public':out,'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}))
